title: Divergence[RESOURCEPACK]
description: Resource pack for the Divergence Mod
body:
Resource pack for the Divergence mod.

Brings back selected textures and sounds from older versions of Minecraft, and more!
This includes classic block textures such as bricks and cobblestone, along with older sounds like the old hurt sound, footstep sounds, doors, etc. It's a small resource pack designed to be used alongside the Divergence mod.

You can find the mod here: [https://modrinth.com/mod/divergence](https://modrinth.com/mod/divergence)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/xe8Gxwz1mbs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


You need Programmer Art enabled **_under_** this resource pack for it to work properly. **(But it's enabled by Default in the mod, and it's already in the correct order).**



All original Minecraft assets are owned by Mojang.
